newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady, recovers early loss.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady, recovers early loss.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered early losses to close mostly steady on Sunday at 42.8400/8460 against the previous close at 42.8400/8450, dealers said.
Some early deals were at 42.8480/8490 per dollar but the local currency firmed as higher local call rates tempted some banks to sell the U.S. currency in favour of taka.

Dealers said call money was traded mostly at 8.0 to 8.5 percent against the previous 7.5-8.5 percent. "There is temporary pressure on liquidity because of some banks' frequent investment in central bank bills," said one dealer.
